analytics.description: Analytics for LiteLLM's <cacheLink>response cache</cacheLink> (e.g. Redis / in-memory): requests answered from cache without calling the LLM provider. Provider-side <promptLink>prompt caching</promptLink> (cached input tokens from Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) is not shown here; see "Prompt Caching Metrics" on the Usage page or individual requests in the Logs page.
analytics.unknownCallTypeNote: Unknown groups spend logs that recorded no endpoint. Older proxy versions wrote those for requests rejected before routing, so they are not necessarily LLM API requests.
analytics.requestsChartHint: Click a red failed-requests segment to see which error codes caused those failures.
analytics.tokensChartTitle: Cached Completion Tokens vs Generated Completion Tokens

coordinationRedis.title: Coordination Redis
coordinationRedis.description: Redis used to coordinate work across proxy pods: cross-pod rate limits, spend tracking, and the pod lock manager. It is configured independently of the response cache.
coordinationRedis.restartNotice: Saved changes take effect on proxy restart.
coordinationRedis.loadFailed: Failed to load coordination Redis settings
coordinationRedis.saveSuccess: Coordination Redis settings saved. Restart the proxy to apply them.
coordinationRedis.updateFailed: Failed to update coordination Redis settings
coordinationRedis.sourceConfiguredHereTooltip: general_settings.coordination_redis is set, so coordination uses its own Redis connection.
coordinationRedis.sourceBorrowedTooltip: No coordination Redis is configured; the proxy reuses the response cache's Redis connection.
coordinationRedis.sourceEnvironmentTooltip: No coordination Redis is configured; the proxy falls back to the REDIS_* environment variables.
coordinationRedis.sourceNotConfiguredTooltip: Cross-pod rate limits, spend tracking, and the pod lock manager have no Redis to coordinate through.

fields.secretAlreadySet: Already set. Enter a new value to replace it.

rules.portRange: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
rules.jsonArraySyntax: Must be a valid JSON array (use double quotes)

url.label: Redis URL
url.help: Full Redis/Valkey connection URL (e.g. redis://:password@host:6379/1). When set, it takes precedence over Host, Port, Password, and Database Index.
url.coordinationHelp: Full Redis/Valkey connection URL (e.g. redis://:password@host:6379/1). When set, it takes precedence over Host, Port, Username, and Password.

host.label: Host
host.help: Redis server hostname or IP address

databaseIndex.label: Database Index
databaseIndex.help: Logical database index to isolate the cache (e.g. 1 for redis://host:6379/1)

startupNodes.label: Startup Nodes
startupNodes.help: List of startup nodes for Redis Cluster (e.g., [{"host": "127.0.0.1", "port": "7001"}])
startupNodes.coordinationHelp: List of startup nodes for Redis Cluster (e.g., [{"host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 7001}])

serviceName.label: Service Name
serviceName.help: Master service name for Redis Sentinel

semanticCacheScope.label: Semantic Cache Scope
semanticCacheScope.help: Who can share a semantic cache hit. Key shares hits between all end users of a key/team/org. End user also isolates per end user; requests without an end user fall back to the key scope.
semanticCacheScope.key: Key (shared by all end users of the key/team/org)

ttl.label: TTL (seconds)
ttl.help: Time-to-live for cached items in seconds

maxConnections.label: Max Connections
maxConnections.help: Maximum number of connections in the connection pool

gcpServiceAccount.label: GCP Service Account
gcpServiceAccount.help: GCP service account for IAM authentication (e.g., projects/-/serviceAccounts/your-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com)

gcpSslCaCerts.label: GCP SSL CA Certs
gcpSslCaCerts.help: Path to SSL CA certificate file for GCP Memorystore Redis

redisType.clusterDescription: Redis Cluster mode for high availability and horizontal scaling
redisType.sentinelDescription: Redis Sentinel mode for high availability with automatic failover
redisType.semanticDescription: Semantic caching that reuses responses for similar prompts
